notes.title: Hunter's Arena: Revolution CBT has ended!
notes.content:
Greetings Hunters,

The week long CBT has recently ended.
Approximately 1,000 users participated in the CBT and many have sent in their opinions about it.

We have gathered all the opinions and will be revamping the game.

[list]
[*]A tutorial is currently in development. We will also make it easy to obtain information through a game guide that will be available on the web and in-game.[/list]
[list][*]A new mode (app) for new users and beginners is also in development. Even if you don't know much about the game, you can enjoy it without any worries.[/list]
[list][*]Camera visibility will be improved as well.[/list]
[list][*]The overall feel of operations and movement will be adjusted too.[/list]
[list][*]Additional escape areas will be added to provide more opportunities for escape and a sense of accomplishment.[/list]

In addition, areas that users found to be inconvenient such as the UI/UX and sound will be corrected as well. We will return with improved features and richer content.

Stay tuned for more to come~
